In the US, companies can buy and sell our personal data without our knowledge or consent. It sounds unbelievable, but it's true.

Theoretically, you can ask companies to remove your data from the internet, but that's easier said than done. Fortunately, Incogni offers a service to handle all of this on your behalf, and 9to5Mac readers can now enjoy an exclusive 45% discount...

Your personal data is being sold

Apple offers several features to help us protect our online privacy, including App Tracking Transparency, Hide My Email, and iCloud Private Relay. Making good use of these tools can help reduce our public digital footprint online.

But these features cannot handle data that has already been leaked. Most people are shocked to learn how much of their information marketers and scammers can obtain simply by purchasing data from data brokers.

When you download a new app or sign up for a new website, those 30-page terms and conditions often contain seemingly harmless clauses, such as authorising the sharing of data with designated partners. In reality, sensitive information like location records may be sold to data brokers and then resold to anyone who can afford it.

Data brokers collect personal data from multiple sources to build detailed personal profiles. Companies can purchase this data to send you spam. Worse still, if scammers obtain this information, they can impersonate familiar organisations to gain your trust for fraudulent purposes.

Remove your family's data

In most US states, you have a legal right to request the deletion of your data from these databases. Unfortunately, since hundreds of companies are involved, the entire process is extremely time-consuming.

Without exception, these companies deliberately make the procedure complicated and intimidating. For example, you cannot submit a single request on behalf of your entire family—each family member must apply separately. Opt-out forms are often hard to find, and sometimes you must fill out lengthy and complicated application forms.

Even if you manage to complete the process, you'll still need to repeat the same procedure regularly in the future, since there is no mechanism to prevent them from purchasing your new data again.

Fortunately, Incogni offers a more convenient solution

The good news is that Incogni can automate the entire process for you. After setting up an account, you can initiate the process for your whole family with just a few clicks.

Incogni will contact hundreds of data brokers on behalf of you and your family, requesting the deletion of your data. The company doesn't just handle it once—it follows up regularly to ensure your family's data doesn't reappear in these databases.

The result is that you'll receive significantly fewer spam messages and robocalls, and you'll be far less likely to be targeted by scammers.
